posts.zh:
dsh-llm-newapi 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。NewAPI（OpenAI 兼容网关）模型接入：注册 `newapi` 路由，仅发现聊天类模型，自动从 models.dev 获取模型参数（上下文窗口、思考强度等）并填充，并在 Web 设置页配置 base URL 与 API Key。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7ca8226bca2d16aad806.html
posts.en:
dsh-llm-newapi is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. NewAPI (OpenAI-compatible gateway) LLM provider: registers a `newapi` route with chat-only model discovery, auto-fills model parameters (context window, reasoning effort) from models.dev, and adds a Web settings section for the base URL and API key.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7ca8226bca2d16aad806.html
